================================================================================
1. BUSINESS SUMMARY & OPERATIONAL SCOPE
================================================================================
DPlanner Photography is a premier Nigerian photography brand with a dedicated physical studio atelier located at 82 De ACE HALL, besides Turaya Food Canteen, in the Yemetu neighborhood of Ibadan, Oyo State.

The studio is equipped with professional strobe lighting, multiple backdrop colors, private dressing/changing facilities, and full air conditioning. While the studio serves clients in Ibadan for headshots, birthdays, solo portraits, maternity, and creative editorial work, lead photographer Samuel Damilare and the DPlanner crew regularly travel across Nigeria—frequently covering weddings in Ibadan, Lagos, Abeokuta, Osogbo, Abuja, and beyond.

Core specialties:
- Controlled studio portraiture
- Natural skin retouching (preserving authentic skin texture, complexions, and traditional fabric textures like Aso-Oke without artificial plastic smoothing)
- Traditional Yoruba, Igbo, and contemporary church wedding photography & cinema film
- Birthday & milestone portraiture
- Corporate conferences, AGMs, summits, and executive portraits

================================================================================
2. DETAILED SERVICES & PRICING
================================================================================

A. STANDARD STUDIO PORTRAITS (Yemetu Studio, Ibadan)
- Price: ₦2,000 per edited picture
- Turnaround: Delivered within 24 hours of picture selection
- Same-day Express Delivery: +₦500 per picture
- Inclusions:
  * Access to controlled strobe lighting setups
  * Choice of backdrop colors
  * Natural skin retouching
  * Private changing room for outfit changes
  * High-resolution digital files delivered via download link

B. CREATIVE CONCEPT SESSIONS (Yemetu Studio or On-Location)
- Price: From ₦3,000 per edited picture
- Turnaround: 24–48 hours depending on concept complexity
- Inclusions:
  * Pre-session moodboard and styling consultation
  * Bespoke creative and artistic lighting setups
  * Posing guidance and art direction from Samuel Damilare
  * Advanced fine-art color grading and skin retouching
  * High-resolution editorial gallery

C. 2026 WEDDING PHOTOGRAPHY & FILM PACKAGES (Valid through 31 Dec 2026)

Package 1: ESSENTIAL PACKAGE
- Price: ₦180,000 (regular price: ₦200,000, ₦20,000 savings)
- Scope: Full-day single-event photography coverage (ceremony + reception)
- Deliverables:
  * 1 Senior Photographer covering the event
  * Minimum 300 curated, high-resolution color-graded photos
  * 1 Framed Portrait print
  * Secure online gallery with download access
  * Turnaround: 3–4 weeks for complete edited photo gallery
- Best for: Intimate weddings, single-ceremony events, or couples focusing purely on essential photographic memories.

Package 2: CLASSIC PACKAGE (Most Popular Choice)
- Price: ₦250,000
- Scope: Complete full-day photo & film coverage (traditional or white wedding)
- Deliverables:
  * 2 Photographers + 1 Videographer / Cinematographer
  * Minimum 450 curated, high-resolution color-graded photos
  * Cinematic HD Highlight Film (3–5 minutes summary of key moments)
  * Full video recording of vows, speeches, and ceremony highlights
  * 2 Framed Portrait prints
  * Secure digital download gallery + USB flash drive delivery
  * Turnaround: Highlight film delivered within 1 week; edited photo gallery within 3–4 weeks
- Best for: Full traditional or church wedding celebrations requiring balanced photo and video coverage.

Package 3: SIGNATURE ALBUM PACKAGE (The Heirloom Collection)
- Price: ₦450,000
- Scope: Comprehensive documentary coverage for luxury and full-scale celebrations
- Deliverables:
  * 2 Senior Photographers + 2 Cinematographers + Lighting Assistant
  * Minimum 600 curated, high-resolution color-graded photos
  * Cinematic HD Wedding Film + Ceremony highlights + Full speeches
  * Luxury 12×24 Flush-Mount Handcrafted Photobook Album (genuine leather/acrylic finish)
  * Customized matching presentation briefcase
  * 3 Large Framed Portrait prints for home display
  * Priority editing turnaround (Highlight film within 1 week; complete gallery within 3–4 weeks)
  * Delivered on custom crystal USB drive and digital gallery
- Best for: Couples who want complete heirloom documentation with a custom handcrafted photobook briefcase collection.

Package 4: PHOTOBOOK ALBUM ADD-ON
- Price: ₦180,000
- Can be added to: Essential Package or Classic Package
- Inclusions:
  * 12×24 Handcrafted luxury flush-mount photobook album
  * Thick lay-flat archival paper (moisture-resistant, non-yellowing)
  * Customized matching presentation briefcase
  * Full album layout design with client preview before print

D. BIRTHDAY, CORPORATE & DOCUMENTARY EVENTS
- Coverage for milestone birthdays, corporate summits, AGMs, product launches, and private dinners.

3. TURNAROUND TIMES & DELIVERY COMMITMENTS
================================================================================
- Studio Portraits: Within 24 hours of client photo selection (express delivery available within hours for +₦500/pic).

- Edited Wedding Photos: Delivered within 3–4 weeks after the wedding.

================================================================================
4. BOOKING TERMS & PAYMENT SCHEDULE
================================================================================
- Studio Sessions: 50% deposit required to confirm appointment. Balance due before final image delivery.
- Weddings & Major Events: 50% non-refundable deposit secures and guarantees your date on our calendar. Dates are held strictly first-come, first-served upon confirmed deposit payment. The 50% balance is due prior to final delivery of photos and films.
- How to Book: WhatsApp (+234 816 820 4080) is the official booking channel. Clients share event date, location, and desired package to receive payment details and written confirmation.
